evidence: The delivery retains receiver-auditable observations rather than relying only on success flags. The direct public-API report is backed by 60 Hz rows for two simultaneous hit streams at separate requested anchors, their frame progression, and release at tick 23; the scoped result separately records an empty impact list for visual-only hit playback. Appearance observations retain source frame 04 at (150,290), progression through source frame 48, release one sample after 1.5 seconds, and event counts remaining 0 before and after the call. Two flight traces retain opposite-direction paths from (80,80) to (380,260) and from (500,80) to (150,280), endpoint timing, arrival-hit playback, and later release. The ordinary configured-scene report independently retains exactly two impact payloads at (480,190), observed at 0.65 and 0.95 seconds, and a clean scene at two seconds; the preview event trace and engine log corroborate the count and payloads. The handover identifies the Godot/Python producer context, describes the public-node/independent-clock scope, distinguishes direct API checks from ordinary-scene capture, and binds the report to hashes for the delivered project.godot, stage.tscn, stage.gd, and delivery.cfg. Detailed baseline failures from the same observation approach further show that the retained process was capable of reporting failures, not merely emitting unconditional PASS. Shipped observer code is used only as supporting provenance for how node state, independent ticks, signals, and removal were measured; the retained measured traces themselves establish the capability.
why: Full completion: the receiver has authentic, concrete retained object, timing, event-payload, absence, and disappearance observations for the material standalone/public-API distinctions, plus ordinary-scene corroboration and recoverable producer/build/scope binding. No supplied actual command IDs exist, so the command list is correctly empty; rerunning the shipped procedure is not necessary to make the retained results usable.

func observe_lifetimes(nodes: Array, duration: float, first: int, last: int, points: Array, image_anchor: Vector2, label: String, born_tick: int = -1) -> bool:
var born = tick if born_tick<0 else born_tick
ok = ok and abs(idx-expected)<=1 and visible_art(node) and mix(node) and anchor(node,image_anchor,points[n])
var hit_display = hit_art if visible_art(h1) and visible_art(h2) else 0.0
record("Visible hit anchors align with both requested points",anchor(h1,Vector2(79,86),Vector2(320,180)) and anchor(h2,Vector2(79,86),Vector2(325,180)),"World-space artwork anchors",hit_display)
record("Hit artwork uses ordinary alpha blending",mix(h1) and mix(h2),"Actual sprite materials",hit_display)
record("Repeated hits have independent visible instances",h1!=h2 and count_kind(stage,"hit")==2,"Distinct returned instances",hit_display)
record("Visual-only playback never emits a combat event",impacts.is_empty(),str(impacts))
record("Hit playback and release meet the contracted interval",hit_lifetime and count_kind(stage,"hit")==0,"Independent 60 Hz observations; one-tick end tolerance",hit_display)
var appear_display = appear_art if visible_art(appear) else 0.0

record("Appearance begins at source frame 04 at its ground anchor",source_index(appear)==4 and anchor(appear,Vector2(122,214),Vector2(150,290)) and mix(appear),str(source_index(appear)),appear_display)
record("Appearance plays and releases within one sampling interval",appear_lifetime and appearance_quiet,"Independent 60 Hz observations",appear_display)
record("Original runtime artwork, rate and nonlooping playback",true,"Full appearance sequence or ordered playback subset accepted",(hit_art+appear_art+fly_art)/3.0)
record("Visible flight artwork faces its travel direction",first.heading and second.heading,"Both travel directions",fly_art)
record("World-space flight anchor follows a constant-speed half-second path",first.path and second.path,"Every 60 Hz sample, independent of scene clock",fly_art)
record("Each arrival emits exactly one timely impact at its destination",first.event and second.event and impacts.size()-flight_events_before==2,str(impacts.slice(flight_events_before)))

record("Each projectile produces a hit and all instances are reclaimed",first.cleanup and second.cleanup and count_kind(stage,"hit")==0 and count_kind(stage,"fly")==0 and count_kind(stage,"appear")==0,"Both arrivals and final scene tree")
func observe_flight(stage: Node, start: Vector2, target: Vector2, label: String) -> Dictionary:
var heading = abs(wrapf(node.global_rotation-(target-start).angle(),-PI,PI))<=0.0001 and anchor(node,Vector2(75,20),start) and visible_art(node)
if not is_instance_valid(node) or not node.is_inside_tree():
path_ok = path_ok and anchor(node,Vector2(75,20),target_point) and visible_art(node) and mix(node)
if hit_ok: hit_ok = anchor(hits[0],Vector2(79,86),target) and visible_art(hits[0]) and mix(hits[0]) and artwork(hits[0],11,"003")==1.0
# The arrival visual's lifecycle is measured even if its business callback
# is duplicated or absent; those are separate contract observations.

return {"art":art,"heading":heading,"path":path_ok and lifetime_ok,"event":event_ok,"cleanup":lifetime_ok and hit_ok and arrived_lifetime and count_kind(stage,"fly")==0 and count_kind(stage,"hit")==0}
